name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)

summary.oneLiner: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover for a small yearly premium.
summary.whatIsIt: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana is a low-cost life insurance scheme. If you are between 18 and 50 years old and have a bank account, you can join every year. If the insured person dies for any reason, their family receives ₹2 lakh. A small premium is automatically deducted from your bank account each year.

benefits.text: Life insurance cover paid to your family if something happens to you

documents.name: Nominee details
documents.why: So your family can receive the claim

howToApply.title: Visit or contact your bank
howToApply.detail: Ask for the PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana enrolment form.

howToApply.title: Give your consent for auto-debit
howToApply.detail: The yearly premium will be deducted automatically from your account.

howToApply.title: Renew every year
howToApply.detail: Cover continues automatically each year unless you opt out.

rules.label: Your age is between 18 and 50
rules.sourceQuote: Any individual having a bank account, aged between 18 and 50 years, who gives consent to join and enable auto-debit, is eligible.

rules.label: You have a bank account
rules.sourceQuote: A savings bank account is required to join the scheme and the premium is auto-debited from it.

jargon.meaning: The amount you pay to keep your insurance cover active.
The person you choose to receive the money if something happens to you.

documentGaps: The exact current premium amount is not stated here and should be checked with your bank.
The document does not mention an income limit.
